summary: A very short 1969 note titled M.I.T., apparently a contact and logistics memo for the MIT site in the early network group. Per the index it replaces RFC 10, and later notes in the series (RFC 24, RFC 27, RFC 30) updated it.

eli5.summary: A short note that gives information about one of the early sites that was joining the network, like an address page in a class directory.
